newsitem.title: USA: Union Acceptance sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Union Acceptance sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Union Acceptance Corp said Friday it expected a net loss for the fourth quarter ending June 30 of $9 million to $11 million, or $0.68 to $0.83 a share, including a $16 million after-tax charge.
"The company has elected to take an after-tax charge to earnings of approximately $16.1 million, or $1.22 per share, in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997," UAC said in a statement.
It said the charge should lead to a credit loss reserve level of about 4.05 percent, compared with 3.00 percent at March 31.
The consumer finance company also said it intends to increase its allowance for credit losses.
"Given the trends in the general economy and the consumer's propensity to file bankruptcy, this action is an appropriate adjustment at this time," said UAC President John Stainbrook.
